note: Parser cases for account record v1 (redmesh-auth.md). value is the raw stored string. password salt/hash are structurally valid bytes, not real argon2id hashes; parsers never verify passwords.

cases.name: json_null_literal_not_tombstone
cases.reason: JSON null (not the exact string null) is not an object

cases.name: account_id_differs_from_field
cases.reason: accountId must equal the hash field

cases.name: account_id_leading_dot
cases.reason: accountId must start with a letter or digit

cases.name: unknown_state
cases.reason: state must be active, deactivated or deleting

cases.name: generation_not_uuid_v4
cases.reason: generation must be a lowercase UUID v4

cases.name: updated_by_invalid
cases.reason: updatedBy must be a canonical account id or @bootstrap

cases.name: created_by_not_canonical
cases.reason: createdBy must be a canonical account id or @bootstrap

cases.name: deactivated_without_state_change
cases.reason: non-active state requires stateChangedAt and stateChangedBy

cases.name: membership_tenant_role_null_tenant
cases.reason: tenant roles require a tenant id

cases.name: membership_empty_tenant_id
cases.reason: tenant id must be tn_ + UUID v4

cases.name: scope_sp_full_and_allowlisted
cases.reason: super_pentester is full portfolio or allowlisted, not both

cases.name: password_salt_unpadded
cases.reason: base64 must be padded and canonical

cases.name: password_salt_noncanonical_trailing_bits
cases.reason: base64 must re-encode to the input

cases.name: state_changed_by_bootstrap
cases.reason: stateChangedBy must be a canonical account id

cases.name: updated_at_not_calendar_date
cases.reason: timestamps must be real calendar dates

cases.name: membership_tenant_id_not_string
cases.reason: tenant id must be tn_ + UUID v4

cases.name: membership_tenant_id_whitespace
cases.reason: tenant id must be tn_ + UUID v4

cases.name: membership_tenant_id_no_prefix
cases.reason: tenant id must be tn_ + UUID v4
